title: Soaked Scroll
wikitext:
'''Soaked Scroll''' drops from [[Sea Herald]].

==As a quest objective==
* Drops from [[Sea Herald]] for {{questlong|Horde|31|A Dark Tide Will Rise}}.
* Provided for {{questlong|Horde|31|To My Father, Vol'jin}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
A dark tide will rise. And with it, this world will return to its rightful owner. All will succumb to His will; all will drown, just as He did.

Though we were asked not to interfere, we have ensured that the stench of the Stormreaver does not leave this island without first breaking the seal. Enthralled by a former ally—one who seeps deep within the Twilight's Hammer—they will see it through.

Queen Azshara and the Sea Witch have yet to make the necessary preparations. Alas, I am told He does not care how long it takes.

A dark tide will rise, and with it, all of this world will return to the Drowned God.
}}
